help.title: How to Play
help.mouse: Mouse: click open ground for the build ring, or pick a card at the bottom and place it. Click a tower to upgrade or sell. Right-click cancels.
help.keyboard: Keyboard: WASD / arrows move the cursor, Enter confirms, Esc cancels, 1-4 quick build, U opens upgrades, Delete sells, Q/E cycle towers, N next wave, F speed, Space pause.
help.gamepad: Gamepad: stick / D-pad move, A confirm, B cancel, X next wave, Y speed, LB/RB cycle towers, Start pause.
help.touch: Touch: tap open ground for the build ring. When building from a card, tap once to preview the range, then tap the same spot to confirm.
help.tip: Pests walk the dirt roads; moths fly straight along the blue dotted lanes, and Boomcaps cannot hit them. More lives left means more stars.
tower.puff.name: Puffcap
tower.puff.role: Area: bursts a spore ring that hits every pest in range.
tower.puff.a.name: Echo Bloom
tower.puff.a.desc: Each spore ring echoes a second time, with more reach.
tower.puff.a2.desc: Louder, faster echoes that sweep whole swarms.
tower.puff.b.name: Rotcap
tower.puff.b.desc: Toxic haze that deals damage over time through any shell.
tower.puff.b2.desc: Poisoned pests spread the haze to neighbours when they fall.
tower.dew.name: Dewcap
tower.dew.role: Slow: flicks chilly dewdrops that make pests dawdle.
tower.dew.a.name: Frostbell
tower.dew.a.desc: Frost waves slow everything nearby and every few rings freeze them.
tower.dew.a2.desc: Deeper frost; freezes come faster and last longer.
tower.dew.b.name: Ambercap
tower.dew.b.desc: Spits sticky sap puddles that slow pests and make them take extra damage.
tower.dew.b2.desc: Wider puddles with a much stronger weakening effect.
tower.thorn.name: Thornspire
tower.thorn.role: Pierce: fires thorns that punch through a whole line of pests.
tower.thorn.a.name: Lancewood
tower.thorn.a.desc: Long-range lances that ignore armour and snipe the toughest pest.
tower.thorn.a2.desc: Heavier lances that skewer even more targets.
tower.thorn.b.name: Bramble Volley
tower.thorn.b.desc: Rapid fan of thorns that shreds crowds of small pests.
tower.thorn.b2.desc: Five-thorn fans at an even faster rate.
tower.boom.name: Boomcap
tower.boom.role: Splash: lobs spore bombs that blast an area. Ground only.
tower.boom.a.name: Scatterbloom
tower.boom.a.desc: Each blast scatters little bomblets for chain explosions.
tower.boom.a2.desc: More bomblets that carpet a whole stretch of road.
tower.boom.b.name: Thunderhead
tower.boom.b.desc: Slow, enormous blasts that also stun.
tower.boom.b2.desc: Devastating blasts with a longer stun.

level.3.desc: The vault sits in the heart of the grove, assaulted from east and west.

tutorial.title: Warden's Guide
tutorial.path: Pests follow the arrows on the dirt road to the seed vault. Moths fly straight in along the blue dotted lane.
tutorial.build: Build a tower on open ground next to the road.
tutorial.build_mouse: Click open ground beside the road to open the build ring and pick a mushroom. You can also pick a card at the bottom and place it.
tutorial.build_touch: Tap open ground beside the road to open the build ring and pick a mushroom.
tutorial.build_pad: Move the cursor next to the road with the stick, press A for the build ring, then A again to build.
tutorial.build_key: Move the cursor with WASD and press Enter, or press 1-4 to pick a tower directly.
tutorial.upgrade: Click a tower to see its upgrades. After tier 2 you choose one of two bloom paths.
tutorial.upgrade_pad: Put the cursor on a tower and press A for upgrades. LB/RB jump between towers.
tutorial.start: Start the first wave when you are ready!
tutorial.start_mouse: Press Start Wave 1 at the top right when ready. F speeds up, Space pauses.
tutorial.start_touch: Tap Start Wave 1 at the top right when ready. The buttons beside it speed up and pause.
tutorial.start_pad: Press X to start the first wave. Y speeds up, Start pauses.
tutorial.start_key: Press N to start the first wave. F speeds up, Space pauses.
